personality_one_liner: A premium, map-centric outdoor app that frames nature through clean typography and earthy tones, resembling modern hiking tools rather than cartoonish pet trackers.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Use whitespace to separate sections instead of heavy borders. Content frames the map, not the other way around.

do's: Bottom tab bar background so the map bleeds under.
Floating map controls (FABs for location, layers).
Filter row at the top of the Explore map.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Interactive map discovery where users can see nearby walks, filter, and interact with pins.

states.loading: Map skeleton or centered spinner over abstract map texture.
states.empty: No walks found in this area. Move map or clear filters.
states.error: Failed to load walks. Check connection.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map. Top floating glass container with Search and filter chips row. Bottom floating FAB for 'Recenter'. BottomSheet overlying the map displaying a horizontal scroll of nearby walks. Map should extend beneath transparent/glass status bar and bottom tab bar.

screens.name: WalkDetails
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of a specific walk, displaying stats, color-coded route map, and community feedback.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero image and title.

screens.layout: Hero image at top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (to ensure white top-bar icons are readable). Sticky bottom CTA 'Start Walk'. Content inside ScrollView: Walk Title, Stats row (distance, duration), Interactive map snippet displaying the color-coded route (Green=off-leash, Orange=caution, Red=leash). Below map: POIs list, Hazards list, and a Community Confirmation card ('Confirmed 2 days ago').

screens.name: CreateWalk
screens.purpose: Allow users to manually draw a route or record their GPS trail.
screens.layout: Top segmented control (Draw vs Record). Large map surface. Bottom sheet form for adding walk metadata (Name, Difficulty, Environment) with a sticky 'Save Walk' primary CTA. Tap map to add POIs or Hazard pins.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User dashboard showing activity stats and saved walks.

states.empty: Illustration of abstract landscape with 'You haven't saved any walks yet'.

screens.layout: Header with User Name and aggregated stats (Total distance, Walks completed). Two-column grid or list for 'My Walks' and 'Saved Walks'. Clean, white cards on soft off-white surfaceTertiary.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid pet-store aesthetics. Do NOT use paw prints, cartoon dogs, or bone icons. Use Phosphor icons matching an outdoor/hiking vibe (Trees, Paths, MapPins, Warning).

Map implementation is critical. Use react-native-maps. Walk routes must be segmented and color-coded explicitly using the semantic colors: success (Green) for off-leash, warning (Orange) for caution, and error (Red) for leash required.
Implement the bottom tab navigation with glassmorphism so the map bleeds under the tabs.
For WalkDetails, use the provided walk_hero images with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim to guarantee back-button visibility.
In the Community Confirmation UI, use a subtle card (surfaceSecondary) with muted text to show 'Last confirmed 2 days ago' alongside an outline button to 'Confirm / Report changes'.
POIs and Hazards should use tinted icon containers (brandTertiary rounded squares) rather than bare icons to maintain a premium look.
